name: opencorporates-mcp
description: OpenCorporates (sales): me, search, get_company. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_opencorporates_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OPENCORPORATES_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_opencorporates_api_token.description: OpenCorporates API token ('available from your account page on OpenCorporates'), sent as the api_token query parameter on every request.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /account_status returns the plan, expiry and calls_remaining (today / this_month) for the token.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Name search ('companies whose name matches the given search term'); `country` maps to country_code. `country` in the result is the OpenCorporates jurisdiction_code (ISO alpha-2, or alpha-2 plus subdivision such as us_de). Company numbers are only unique per jurisdiction: pass `<jurisdiction_code>/<company_number>` (raw.company.jurisdiction_code + raw.company.company_number) to get_company. per_page max 100, page ≤ 100. industry_codes[] is documented but its inner shape is not, so `industry` stays in raw.
